key.name: downloads-folder
key.description: Folder to watch. Empty uses the XDG Downloads directory.

key.name: view-mode
key.summary: Show downloads as a grid or as a list

key.name: sort-by
key.summary: Sort by date added or date modified

key.name: icon-style
key.summary: Dock icon: a stack of the newest downloads, or the Downloads folder

key.name: generate-thumbnails
key.summary: Create previews for downloads that have no thumbnail yet

key.name: animate-icon
key.summary: Bounce the dock icon when a download finishes

key.name: show-badge
key.summary: Show a dot on the dock icon for downloads you have not looked at

key.name: dock-after
key.summary: Id of the dock icon the Downloads icon was dropped after

key.name: dock-before
key.summary: Id of the dock icon the Downloads icon was dropped before

key.name: dock-index
key.summary: Slot the Downloads icon was dropped in (-1: default, before the Trash)

key.name: clear-before
key.summary: Hide downloads added before this time (µs since epoch)
key.description: Set by the Clear button. Files are never deleted.

key.name: last-seen
key.summary: When the stack was last opened (µs since epoch)
